name: Asheville East KOA Holiday
evidence: KOA site map PDF (revised Aug 2026): back-ins A1-A10 and pull-thrus B28/B29 typed 'Riverfront' along the Swannanoa; Wayback post-Helene 2025-02 z19: A-row access road ~5-10 m off the river bank, pads between, scattered trees only. Imagery predates rebuild, map decides

name: At The Ridge Campground & RV Park
evidence: NC911 2023 leaf-off z20 (Wayback 22252): gravel pads ~15-30 m across the sites' own open lawn (picnic tables) from the rocky North Fork French Broad channel (OSM river line, footbridge), scattered bank trees only; operator: premium 'River Campsite' #4/#6 FHU 'on the river'

name: Cashie River Treehouses & Campground
evidence: Esri z19 at 35.9848,-76.9405: RV pads ~90 m from water, behind a gravel parking lot, building and woods; only the boat-launch canal head reaches the lot; Cashie River ~120+ m W through swamp forest. Campspot 'Waterfront' tag is the launch

name: Mayo Lake Park
evidence: Person Co. per-site park map (2026 PDF): Area 2 RV/tent sites 1-28 ring the peninsula tip, 3-23 at the shore; Esri/NC911 leaf-off z19 at 36.4750,-78.8743: Area 2 gravel loop pads ~12-15 m (N side) to ~20-30 m (S) from Mayo Lake through open-understory woods. Old pin was in woods E of Area 1

name: Lake Powhatan Campground
evidence: rec.gov 231995 site coords on Esri: nearest RV site 048 (Lakeside loop) ~50 m from Lake Powhatan behind forest and the lakeshore road; no Proximity to Water flags; lake not visible from pads

name: Linville Falls Campground
evidence: rec.gov 234036 site coords on Esri: loops at 35.967,-81.933 (old pin ~800 m W on rural houses); nearest RV pads (Loop A west) ~70-85 m from the Linville River behind a riparian tree strip and post-Helene sand flat; no water flags; agrees with AWH firsthand call

name: Almond Boat and RV Park
evidence: operator site plan: RV sites 3-60 lie along the woods road SE of the marina; NC911 2023 leaf-off z18: those pads sit 30-50 m from Fontana's high-water edge behind wooded slopes; operator: 'not water front ... woodsy'. Old call read the marina/cabin peninsula

name: Jackrabbit Mountain Campground
evidence: rec.gov 234180 site coords on Esri leaf-off z19: Loop A RV sites 018-020 (RV NONELECTRIC, 55-60 ft) ~12-20 m from Lake Chatuge's high-water/vegetation edge over an open, scattered-tree slope; rec.gov: some sites 'lie on the water's edge'

name: Old Fort RV Park
evidence: operator site plan (2026): lots 20-40 back onto Brevard Creek, 'stairs down to creek'; Wayback post-Helene 2025 z19: west-row pad ends ~15-20 m from the creek channel across a cleared graded bank; 2022 NC911 shows flat field to the creek (low bank, not a bluff)

name: Oyster Point Campground (Newport River)
evidence: Esri z19 at 34.7601,-76.7630: south spurs end ~30-35 m from the Newport River behind a continuous wooded/marsh fringe; rec.gov 262810 tags 01,05,07,09,11,13,15 'Riverfront' (trailer sites 01,05,11,15) but pads are not at the shore; default down
